direct_findings.explanation: These call instructions produce report options rather than the source-returned report response. Processing additionally invokes report_function and discards invoked_response, after which control executes the shared report body. That represents an extra invocation and disconnects the call-local response demands from the response actually returned.
direct_findings.suggestion: Represent each helper invocation once. Connect its actual constructed options to that invocation's report execution and connect the resulting acquired response, after enabled saving, to the helper return. Preserve argument construction separately from the call's returned value.

direct_findings.explanation: Source-supported collection traversals are hidden inside value instructions. Processing for_each structures do not establish the required CFG loops. The latest-result filter also has no executable connection from its computed sanitized substring to each member's inclusion test.
direct_findings.suggestion: Expose the map/filter traversals with collection-consuming headers, current-member values, body operations and backedges. Bind the latest filter's actual substring and current path to its predicate. Sorting details may remain a local opaque calculation without inventing a sorting algorithm.
